create.name: Rolf Gates
create.bio:
Rolf Gates is a vinyasa yoga and meditation teacher and the author of Meditations from the Mat, a book of daily reflections that walks through the eight limbs of yoga and has become a standard companion for students and teacher trainees. Raised around Boston in a family with a long line of ministers, he served as a US Army Ranger and later worked as a social worker before yoga and meditation became his life's work. He leads the Kripalu School of Yoga, teaching on its 200-hour and advanced trainings, and has run his own vinyasa intensives and teacher trainings in the United States and abroad for many years.

His teaching joins a strong, flowing physical practice with Buddhist-influenced mindfulness and the ethical teachings of the Yoga Sutras, and he speaks plainly about using practice to meet ordinary life with steadiness and kindness. Through his own Gates Yoga he offers self-paced online 200-hour and 300-hour vinyasa trainings with one-to-one mentoring, an online studio with weekly live classes and a library of recorded practices, and seasonal study groups for teachers on pranayama and meditation. A second book of reflections, Meditations on Intention and Being, followed in 2015, and he wrote the children's partner-yoga book Yoga Friends with Mariam Gates.

books.title: Meditations from the Mat: Daily Reflections on the Path of Yoga
books.author: Rolf Gates and Katrina Kenison
books.description: A year of short daily readings that move in turn through each of the eight limbs of yoga, mixing philosophy with stories from Rolf's own practice and teaching. Many yoga teacher trainings use it as a set text.

books.title: Meditations on Intention and Being: Daily Reflections on the Path of Yoga, Mindfulness, and Compassion
books.author: Rolf Gates
books.description: A second book of daily reflections, this time drawing on Buddhist teachings as well as yoga. The readings look at intention, effort and compassion in everyday life.

books.title: Yoga Friends: A Pose-by-Pose Partner Adventure for Kids
books.author: Mariam Gates and Rolf Gates
books.description: An illustrated picture book that shows children how to practise yoga poses in pairs. Part of the Good Night Yoga series from Sounds True.

courses.title: Quiet Mind, Steady Heart
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, combining yoga, breathwork and meditation. The days explore the idea, common to many wisdom traditions, of resting in things as they are, and whether something trustworthy lies at the heart of experience.

courses.title: Online Yoga Studio: The Yoga Room
courses.description: A monthly subscription to Rolf's live online classes (60 and 90 minutes, plus a 30-minute meditation), all of them recorded. Members also get unlimited use of his library of past classes.

courses.title: Online 200 Hour Vinyasa Teacher Training
courses.description: A self-paced, Yoga Alliance registered foundation training that can begin at any time. Video lectures, reading and practice teaching are supervised one to one by Rolf and his practicum coaches.
courses.price: $2,675 USD paid in full (or $500 USD deposit plus 10 monthly payments of $250 USD)

courses.title: Online 300 Hour Vinyasa Teacher Training
courses.description: An advanced, self-paced vinyasa training for teachers who have already finished a 200-hour course. Study and practicum teaching are mentored individually, and the course can be started at any time.
courses.price: $3,000 USD paid in full (or $3,250 USD on a payment plan)
